records.label: JS heap metrics
records.detail: performance.memory is absent (expected on WebKit) — the debug HUD must show MEMORY: UNAVAILABLE rather than a fabricated figure

records.label: WebXR
records.detail: navigator.xr is absent — WebXR is the only standards-track route to device depth or AR pose from a browser, so neither is reachable here

records.label: Native app bridge
records.detail: no window.webkit.messageHandlers bridge — the page is not hosted by a native app, so no native iOS framework can be reached from JavaScript

records.label: Camera depth
records.detail: no depth-related media constraint and no WebXR depth-sensing route (webxr=false) — DEPTH: UNAVAILABLE. Any depth used later must be labelled MONOCULAR ESTIMATE and never presented as native depth (§44)

records.label: Native ARKit
records.detail: ARKit has no JavaScript API. Probed for the only possible surface — a native message bridge — and found none. ARKit: UNAVAILABLE

records.label: RoomPlan
records.detail: RoomPlan has no JavaScript API. Probed for the only possible surface — a native message bridge — and found none. RoomPlan: UNAVAILABLE

records.label: Metric scale
records.detail: A monocular camera provides no absolute scale (§18, §90). No depth sensor, WebXR session or native bridge is reachable to supply one, so the world will be built in LOCAL UNITS and SCALE stays UNKNOWN until something actually measures it.

spec.title: Camera permission granted, real stream opens
spec.input: user tap -> getUserMedia walking the constraint ladder (rear camera, 1280x720 ideal)
spec.expected: a MediaStream with a live video track reporting real width, height and frameRate
spec.passCriteria: a stream opened with settings reporting finite width >= 1 and height >= 1, and the video element reported a non-zero size while frames were arriving
spec.failureCondition: getUserMedia throws while permission was granted; zero-size settings; the element never reported a size despite an open stream

testResults.reason: a real stream opened and rendered real geometry; the achieved facing mode and ladder rung are recorded as achieved rather than as requested

spec.title: Camera permission denied, handled without a fake stream
spec.input: getUserMedia rejected by the user or by Safari website settings
spec.expected: state CAMERA_PERMISSION_DENIED, no stream held, no image presented
spec.passCriteria: the rejection maps to CAMERA_PERMISSION_DENIED; no video track is held; no preview is presented; the error carries a recovery action
spec.failureCondition: the denial is swallowed, or any placeholder or previously captured image is presented

testResults.observed: DENIED — NotAllowedError — no stream held, no image presented
testResults.reason: the denial path was verified; carried over from a run 894 s ago at https://hsgwyuki0429-design.github.io (convenience only — the repository gate requires a committed bundle that observed this scenario directly)

spec.title: 30 seconds of continuous frame capture
spec.input: an open stream observed via requestVideoFrameCallback (rAF + currentTime as fallback)
spec.expected: frames arriving continuously for at least 30 000 ms
spec.passCriteria: observed >= 30 000 ms; mean delivered fps >= 15; longest gap <= 2000 ms; the track does not end on its own before the window fills; page never hidden
spec.failureCondition: any of the above unmet; backgrounding counts as a failure, not an exclusion. Never opening a stream is PENDING, not FAIL

testResults.observed: 42.3 s, 1263 frames, 29.84 fps, longest gap 128 ms, via requestVideoFrameCallback
testResults.reason: frames arrived continuously for the full window with no stall beyond tolerance

spec.title: Moving the camera changes the image
spec.input: frames sampled at ~4 Hz into a 64x48 grayscale buffer; mean absolute difference and mean luma per sample
spec.expected: peak frame-to-frame difference rises far above the sensor noise floor while the camera moves
spec.passCriteria: >= 20 samples; maxMad >= 8 (a level a static scene cannot reach after downsampling); peak luma > 2
spec.failureCondition: difference stays at the noise floor (frozen or still image), or the frame is uniformly black

testResults.observed: 158 samples; MAD min 15.919 / median 38.622 / max 68.812; luma 58.72..184.42
testResults.reason: peak difference 68.812 against a floor of 15.919 and a median of 38.622 (1.8x the median), luma up to 184.42

spec.title: Orientation change
spec.input: the device is rotated; screen.orientation change and orientationchange events
spec.expected: the change is observed, capture continues across it, and the track survives
spec.passCriteria: at least one orientation change with a changed angle; a frame within 2000 ms of the change; the track does not end on its own during the session
spec.failureCondition: capture stalls across the rotation, or the track ends on its own

testResults.observed: 2 change(s), now at 0°, next frame after 38 ms, 1043 frames since
testResults.reason: capture continued across the rotation without the track ending

spec.title: Error-state completeness
spec.input: the DOMException-name to engine-state mapping table
spec.expected: every mapped name resolves to a §57 state with a non-empty recovery action
spec.passCriteria: no unmapped name among those the platform can raise; no state without a recovery
spec.failureCondition: any gap — advisory, since it is a property of the code and is covered by unit tests

testResults.reason: every getUserMedia rejection the platform can raise maps to a declared state with a recovery action; an unrecognised name still fails closed to UNAVAILABLE
